svg.title: Chicken
svg.desc: Standing White Leghorn chicken with layered white feathers, red comb and wattles, yellow beak, shanks, and anisodactyl feet. Biological basis: Chicken embryos are accessible in ovo for developmental manipulation, while adult birds support immunology, infectious-disease, and agricultural research.
